searchText: Hi everyone. I'm Brandon; Full-stack dev with my current focus on dotnet/C#. Been playing with and following Ethereum since it's inception and finally decided to try and get more involved. Nice to meet everyone and congrats to everyone on the successful upgrade! 🦇 🔊
